punchline: Quanah changed his methods and stayed at the head of his people.
thirty_sec: In 1875 Quanah Parker led the Quahadi Comanche to Fort Sill. Federal agents named him principal chief, and for about 25 years he promoted schools and ranching. In 1905 Theodore Roosevelt visited him at the Star House.
question: In the change ahead, which method are you ready to drop, and which tie will you keep?
key_contrast: The method changed; the ties stayed.
